stem: Oakhurst Freight's `subnet_id` variable has no `default` argument, and the caller doesn't supply one before running `terraform plan`. What does Terraform do?

choices.text: Terraform treats it as an empty string and continues
Terraform prompts for a value before it generates a plan
Terraform substitutes the value of an identically-named environment variable automatically, with no `TF_VAR_` prefix needed
Terraform reuses whatever value that variable held on the previous successful apply

rationale: With no default, Terraform prompts the user to supply a value before it can generate a plan; it doesn't guess an empty string, and there is no silent fallback. Automatic substitution from an identically-named environment variable does not happen -- Terraform only reads environment variables carrying the TF_VAR_ prefix. Terraform also doesn't remember a variable's value across runs on its own, so there is nothing to reuse from a prior apply.
